title: Token Torrent
one_liner: Talk for ten seconds and see how much text an avatar could write in that time at today's speed versus a million tokens per second.
speaker: Dave Blundin
context: Dave said real-time avatars run on dumb models today. He expects a jump from about 100 to a million tokens per second within 18 months, enough to write a full book series every second you speak.
demo: The visitor presses a 'Speak' timer (or types a sentence) while two panes fill with text, one at 100 tokens/s and one at up to 1,000,000 tokens/s, shown as a page counter and a growing bookshelf. A speed slider moves between the two figures on a log scale, and a counter shows how many novel-length books fit into the visitor's own speaking time.
data_plan: The 100 and 1,000,000 tokens/s figures and the 18-month window come from the episode. Words per token and book length are labelled estimates. Filler text is generated locally.
risks: Book-length and token-to-word conversions are my estimates and must be labelled. The million tokens/s figure is a prediction, not a current product.
